drivingQuestion: Is a purchaser who enhanced the stolen item paid for the enhancement?

segments.he: בָּעֵי רָבָא: הִשְׁבִּיחַ לוֹקֵחַ, מַהוּ? בָּתַר דְּבַעְיַהּ, הֲדַר פַּשְׁטַהּ: מָה מָכַר רִאשׁוֹן לַשֵּׁנִי? כׇּל זְכוּת שֶׁתָּבֹא לְיָדוֹ.
segments.en: «Rava raises a dilemma» related to the aforementioned halakha: «What is» the halakha if «a purchaser enhanced» the stolen item? Must the robbery victim pay the purchaser for the enhanced value or not? «After» Rava «raised the dilemma, he then resolved it: What has the first» person «sold to the second» in any sale? He has sold «any rights that will come into his possession.» Since the robber had the rights to the value of his enhancements to the stolen item, he sold those rights to the purchaser as well.

moves.summary: What if the purchaser enhanced the stolen item?
The seller sells all rights that come to him, so the purchaser is paid.
moves.about: whether a purchaser who enhanced the stolen item is paid for it: yes, the seller sold all rights that would come to him
